content:
The highly anticipated fourth season of Ted Lasso has returned (watch link), and Apple TV executive Eddy Cue recently hinted that the series has a very long and bright future beyond this season.

Eddy Cue said Ted Lasso still has 'plenty of stories left to tell' to support future seasons

Apple has not officially renewed Ted Lasso for a fifth season yet, but all signs suggest that beyond the currently airing fourth season, there will be at least two more seasons.

Deadline reported last year that the cast has signed on for a three-season deal, corresponding to what is rumored to be Jason Sudeikis's vision for a new three-season storyline.

As the series returns, Eddy Cue, Apple's head of services, was asked about a potential fifth season and beyond.

In a red carpet interview with ScreenRant, when discussing the possibility of a Ted Lasso season 5, Cue said:

Although Cue did not specifically confirm any plans, he essentially said Apple is committed to continuing the Ted Lasso story for as long as possible.

This news is not surprising, but it is encouraging to hear. Hopefully it means we still have a long way to go before saying goodbye to these characters.

Ted Lasso season 4 premieres new episodes every Wednesday through October 7, and two episodes are now available on Apple TV.

Are you excited about Ted Lasso's return? What are your impressions of the new season? Share with us in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can subscribe through the Apple One bundle deal.
